spans.s: हडि m. (-डिः) A sort of stocks or wooden fetters. “हाडिकाठ”

हडिक m. (-कः) A sweeper, a servant of the lowest caste and meanest
function.
 E. हठ् to be wicked, इकक् aff.; also हड्डिक ।

हड्ड n. (-ड्डं)
 1. A bone.
 2. A sweeper: see the last.
 E. हठ्-ड ।

हड्डक m. (-कः) A sweeper, a Mehter.
 E. कन् added to the last.

हड्डज n. (-जं) The marrow of the bones.
 E. हड्ड a bone, ज born.
